svg.aria-label: Runtime view of the webshop: shoppers reach Front Door, which routes to the storefront and through API Management to the catalog and checkout APIs; those use SQL, Cosmos DB, Redis, storage, Key Vault, AI Search and OpenAI; orders flow through Service Bus to the order processor, and blob uploads raise Event Grid events.
svg.title: Webshop runtime view
svg.text: Solid blue: synchronous HTTPS request path.
Every data service is reached over private endpoints;
only Front Door, API Management and Checkout have public endpoints.
